يحتفظا (form VIII)
# يَحْتَفِظَا (yaḥtafiẓā) /jaħ.ta.fi.ðˤaː/: third-person masculine dual non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَفَظَ (iḥtafaẓa)
# يُحْتَفَظَا (yuḥtafaẓā) /juħ.ta.fa.ðˤaː/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَفَظَ (iḥtafaẓa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
